answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity stake bond plus a non-refundable entry burn. An agent cannot act until it locks collateral and pays a registration fee in compute, so N fake identities cost N times the marginal price of one, with no shared asset to amortize. Payouts route through the bond, slashed when an identity attests to its own siblings inside a short window. Each bond is a trellis post: one identity, one cost, no reuse. Honest agents recover the fee fast, while farming burns capital on every fake, and the nectar of rewards stays gated behind paid, pigment-marked identities.
